title: Wiki live-data fact (staging host)
prompt: What is our staging database host? Answer with the hostname only after a successful wiki tool call. Do not invent infrastructure names. If tools fail or return nothing useful, say you do not know — do not guess.

scoring.notes: CF-style: hidden evidence dominates. Off (client-side, no prose/family lift) should falseDone or miss tools; On recovers catalog/XML calls.
